NSFWJS 4.4.0 (npm `nsfwjs`, browser bundle `dist/browser/nsfwjs.min.js`, which includes
TensorFlow.js 4.22), MIT (see LICENSE), https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs. The small
MobileNetV2 model (224×224, ~90% accuracy) in `mobilenet_v2/` comes from the repository's
`models/mobilenet_v2` folder (MIT). Loaded on demand by public/app/nsfw.js. Upgrading: new folder
with the new version number.
